answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 6874 Country: India Title: I WANT TO KNOW THAT IT IS LEGAL TO DO LIFE INSURANCE & TO BECOME LIFE INSURANCE AGENT IN THE EYES OF SHARIYAT. Question: ASSALAMUALIKUM I WANT TO KNOW THAT IT IS LEGAL TO DO LIFE INSURANCE & TO BECOME LIFE INSURANCE AGENT IN THE EYES OF SHARIYAT. Answer ID: 6874 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 710/710=M/1429) Life insurance consists of interest and gambling which have been declared haram by the Quran. Therefore, it is unlawful to be agent of life insurance. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
